patch.summary: Amplemarket implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Amplemarket by mapping current sales-intelligence workflows to Amplemarket objects, confirming plan gates for built-in calling (Growth, Elite), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gmail) after data checks.
bullets: Integrate after: data quality pass on Salesforce

blocks.heading: Amplemarket day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Amplemarket setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for prospecting, data enrichment, email sequences before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Outbound-led B2B teams investing in AI multichannel engagement before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Salesforce and HubSpot before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover built-in calling (Growth, Elite)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.
Do not expand seats until prospecting is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Startup already list price annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Contact volume and included seats differ sharply by plan (27k / 140k / 400k contacts).

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Duo Voice called out on Growth packaging versus Startup.

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Amplemarket plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Startup
lines.description: Trial available · up to 2 included users, up to 27,000 contacts · Unlocks: prospecting, data enrichment, lead management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Growth
lines.description: Trial available · up to 4 included users, up to 140,000 contacts · Contact sales · Unlocks: built-in calling · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

lines.label: Elite
lines.description: Trial available · up to 10 included users, up to 400,000 contacts · Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.title: Validate sales-intelligence fit before a deep Amplemarket rollout
blocks.body: If Amplemarket fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Amplemarket object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
If blocked, evaluate Apollo.io before sunk-cost expansion
